snippet.title: Tanuki: Pon's Summer — IGN Live Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Tanuki: Pon's Summer on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3218570/TANUKI_Pons_Summer/

The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair.
Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!
